historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works' issuance of a permit to erect a structure at 2015 Buchanan Street, with stipulations that the permit holder bear all costs of an engineering study to determine whether the foundation must be changed, including design specifications necessary to meet City permit requirements, and bear one half of any costs necessary for reconstruction of the appellant's foundation.
